description: This file defines a final class 'Utils' with static utility methods for handling streams, HTTP requests, and URIs within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library. It includes functions for stream copying, hashing, request modification, URI redaction, and safe resource handling.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for stream handling, request modification, URI redaction, and safe resource operations within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library.

methods.name: caselessRemove
methods.description: Removes specified keys from an array case-insensitively.

methods.name: copyToStream
methods.description: Copies data from a source stream to a destination stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: copyToString
methods.description: Reads data from a stream into a string up to a maximum length.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash of a stream's contents using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Clones and modifies an HTTP request with specified changes.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from a stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: redactUserInfo
methods.description: Redacts the password in the user info part of a URI.

methods.name: streamFor
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from various resource types, including strings, resources, iterators, objects, null, and callables.

methods.name: tryFopen
methods.description: Safely opens a file stream, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: tryGetContents
methods.description: Safely reads the contents of a stream, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: uriFor
methods.description: Returns a UriInterface for a string or UriInterface, creating a new Uri if needed.
